notes: Food is taxed at the full rate (4.2% through June 30, 2027).
Barber and beauty services, laundry and dry cleaning, and auto repair labor: taxed (FTA 2017 survey answer).
Motor fuel is exempt from the general sales tax (per-gallon excise instead).
State rate 4.2% through June 30, 2027, then 4.5% unless extended.
Tobacco is assumed taxed at the general rate (excise taxes left out); not verified state by state.
gaps: South Dakota counties do not levy a general sales tax; local taxes are municipal. On reservations with a tribal tax agreement the tribal tax (jurisdiction type 49, equal to the state rate) takes the place of the state tax for covered sales; it is left out, so those areas show the state rate.
